strategy_type.summary: Long options (long calls or puts, 'naked' = uncovered directional bets). NOT a premium-selling screen.
details: IVP percentile (not hard thresholds) determines when IV is cheap enough to buy — low IVP = low IV crush risk on entry
Goal: capture vol expansion + directional move combined (not one or the other)
Regime + macro provide directional conviction (which side: call vs put)
Per-stock IVP is the primary entry filter; regime is the environmental context

regime_integration.summary: Read HMM output file from regime-detection project. Do NOT run the model inside derivative-algo.
details: regime-detection runs separately (daily or weekly), exports its CSV
derivative-algo reads that file for: raw FRED features (yield slope T10Y2Y, NFCI, VIX level) + regime dwell context (how long in current state)
Display as macro overlay header alongside option candidates
Transition probabilities and regime label itself were NOT selected as primary — user prefers raw FRED context + dwell time
Concern: both model quality (HMM not reliable enough live) and operational (JAX/NumPyro too heavy to run daily)

dte_target.summary: 60-90 DTE as default (quarterly horizon). 21-45 DTE preserved as --dte-short mode.
details: Primary mode: 60-90 DTE for macro/regime-driven longer-dated plays
Secondary mode: --dte-short flag for 21-45 DTE (original scanner behavior)
Clean break from old DTE_SWEET_MIN/MAX = 21/45 as primary
